ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the left figure is a profile map of the seafloor topography of the East China Sea. In the figure, from Shanghai, the East China Sea continental shelf to the Okinawa Trough, the Ryukyu Islands, and the Pacific Ocean, Diaoyu Island is marked in the eastern part of the East China Sea continental shelf, near the west side of the Okinawa Trough, and its position is not in the center of the deep sea; the right figure shows that Diaoyu Island is rocky land exposed in the sea. Then reason: Diaoyu Island is located on a raised land part on the continental shelf and is connected with the continental shelf topography. According to the classification of island genesis, islands distributed on the continental shelf and connected with continental geological structures belong to continental islands. Therefore, Diaoyu Island belongs to a continental island.

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：左图显示东海海底剖面，钓鱼岛位于东海大陆架上，西侧接近中国大陆方向，东侧才是明显下陷的冲绳海槽；右图显示钓鱼岛为海中露出的陆地。再推理：钓鱼岛不是位于深海中央，而是大陆架上的陆地高起部分。根据“大陆架上与大陆相连的岛屿为大陆岛”的分类规则，判断钓鱼岛属于大陆岛。
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：左图是东海海底地形剖面图，图中从上海、东海大陆架到冲绳海槽、琉球群岛和太平洋，钓鱼岛标在东海大陆架东部、冲绳海槽西侧附近，位置并不是深海中央；右图显示钓鱼岛是海中露出的岩质陆地。再推理：钓鱼岛位于大陆架上的陆地高起部分，与大陆架地形相联系。按岛屿成因分类，分布在大陆架上、与大陆地质构造相联系的岛屿属于大陆岛。因此钓鱼岛属于大陆岛。

Therefore, Diaoyu Island belongs to a continental island.
